roots.origin: 拉丁语 firmare（使坚固、使稳固），来自 firmus（坚固的）
roots.core_concept: to make steady and dependable / 把东西弄到稳固可靠、不会动摇
roots.core_image: 一根立柱被夯实进土里，无论怎么推它都纹丝不动

roots.origin: 拉丁语 nuntiare（通告、报信），来自 nuntius（信使、消息）
roots.core_concept: to carry word / 把消息送达人前、让众人都听到
roots.core_image: 一名信使跑到广场中央，把一则消息高声喊给所有人

roots.origin: 拉丁语 cor/cordis（心，也指胸、膛），法语借入时变 cour/courage
roots.core_concept: the heart and chest as the seat of inner strength / 心与胸膛，内里勇气与热忱的所在
roots.core_image: 胸腔里一团搏动的心，支撑人迎着压力把力量放出去

roots.origin: 拉丁语 pati（承受、忍耐），过去分词 passus
roots.core_concept: to bear, to undergo, to endure / 承受外来作用而不被压垮
roots.core_image: 人背着压到身上的重量，原地稳住、慢慢承受

concepts.core_image: 立柱被夯进土里，受推仍纹丝不动

concepts.concept: to carry and publish a message
concepts.core_image: 信使把消息送到广场中央对众人高声宣告

concepts.concept: the heart as the seat of courage
concepts.core_image: 胸腔中搏动的心支撑人迎着压力发力

concepts.concept: to bear and endure without breaking
concepts.core_image: 人背负压下的重量原地稳住慢慢承受

words.root_logic: firm（坚固）→ 牢固不移、确定的
words.origin: 拉丁语 firmus（坚固的、结实的）
words.native_definition: steady, resolute, and not easily moved or changed
words.core_concept: set so solidly it will not strain or shift – 安放得结实坚固、不松动不移位
words.core_image: 一根桩子被深深钉进地面，推上去只是更稳
examples: She kept a firm hold on the rope.
The manager gave a firm answer.
semantic_expansions: 坚固的：质地坚实不松动
坚决的：立场笃定不打折扣
公司：英文重新借回 firm 作营业实体

words.root_logic: af-（ad- 靠向）+ firm（坚固）→ 把话坚定地确认下来
words.origin: 拉丁语 affirmare（使确定），来自 ad＋firmare
words.native_definition: to state positively that something is true
words.core_concept: pressing a claim until it stands solid – 把一句话说到坚硬稳固、坐实为真
words.core_image: 某人的表态被重重按下，像盖章一样坐实
examples: The witness affirmed the account.
She affirmed her support for the plan.
semantic_expansions: 断言/确认：把说法坚定地说到坐实为真

words.root_logic: con-（完全）+ firm（坚固）→ 使原先的话头被完全坐实
words.origin: 拉丁语 confirmare（加强确认），来自 con＋firmare
words.native_definition: to show that something is true, certain, or definite
words.core_concept: settling a suspicion into a fixed fact – 把尚不确定的事坐实为定局
words.core_image: 机票座位号得到第二处核对，原先的犹豫落了地
examples: The test confirmed the diagnosis.
Please confirm your attendance by Friday.
semantic_expansions: 证实/确认：使不确定之事坐实为确定事实

words.root_logic: an-（ad- 靠向）+ nounce（通告）→ 把消息正式说到众人面前
words.origin: 拉丁语 annuntiare（宣告），来自 ad＋nuntiare
words.native_definition: to make something known publicly and formally
words.core_concept: bringing a piece of news to the crowd's attention – 把一则消息正式送达众人面前
words.core_image: 主持人上台，向全场公开念出那条新消息
examples: The company announced a new product.
They announced the winner last night.
semantic_expansions: 宣布/公布：把消息正式公开告知众人

words.root_logic: de-（向下、出）+ nounce（通告）→ 当众公开谴责、斥责
words.origin: 拉丁语 denuntiare（正式告知、谴责）
words.native_definition: to publicly condemn or strongly criticize
words.core_concept: speaking a public farewell of blame against someone – 当众发布对某人的公开谴责
words.core_image: 发言人站在人前，把某种丑行当众指认出来
examples: The mayor denounced the violence.
Critics denounced the new policy.
semantic_expansions: 谴责/公开指责：当众批判某种言行

words.root_logic: pro-（向前）+ nounce（通告）→ 把音从往前送出来正式说清
words.origin: 拉丁语 pronuntiare（宣读出、说出）
words.native_definition: to speak a word with its proper sound, or declare officially
words.core_concept: pushing a sound out to the front so it is clearly heard – 把音节向前送出、让人听清
words.core_image: 舌尖把每个音节推到前面，清清楚楚念出来
examples: How do you pronounce this word?
The judge pronounced the sentence.
semantic_expansions: 发音：把语音正确地念出来
宣判/宣布：正式说出具有效力的结论

words.root_logic: cour（心）+ -age → 把心放进胸膛去面对凶险的一种力量
words.origin: 法语 courage，来自 cœur（心）
words.native_definition: the ability to face danger or difficulty without giving in
words.core_concept: the strength one draws from the heart when pressure mounts – 压力压顶时从心里提出的那股劲
words.core_image: 一个人在威胁面前按住心跳，仍朝前迈出一步
examples: It took great courage to speak up.
Soldiers fought with courage.
semantic_expansions: 勇气/胆量：面对凶险时内心撑起的力量

words.root_logic: en-（使进入）+ courage（勇气）→ 使勇气注入人心中
words.origin: 法语 encourager，来自 en＋courage
words.native_definition: to give someone confidence or support to do something
words.core_concept: pouring courage into another's heart so they dare – 把勇气注进对方心里让他敢去行动
words.core_image: 一只手搭上肩，对方心里便多了迈步的底气
examples: The coach encouraged the players.
She encouraged me to apply.
semantic_expansions: 鼓励/激励：把信心和勇气送入他人心中

words.root_logic: dis-（除去）+ courage（勇气）→ 把勇气从人心里抽走
words.origin: 法语 décourager，来自 dis＋courage
words.native_definition: to make someone lose confidence or willingness
words.core_concept: pulling the heart's courage away so one no longer dares – 把心中勇气抽走、让人不敢再试
words.core_image: 一连串打击让原本高涨的心气一点点泄掉
examples: Don't let failure discourage you.
The price discouraged most buyers.
semantic_expansions: 使气馁/使灰心：抽走人行动的勇气

words.root_logic: cord（心）+ -ial → 从心里发出、热诚真挚的
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 cordialis（与心有关的），来自 cor
words.native_definition: warm and friendly in manner
words.core_concept: coming straight from the heart, unguarded and warm – 由心直接流出、真挚热诚
words.core_image: 主人握住的双手带有发自内心的热乎劲
examples: The two leaders had a cordial meeting.
He gave us a cordial welcome.
semantic_expansions: 热诚的/由衷的：从心里直接流出、真挚亲切

words.root_logic: pati（承受）→ 愿意稳稳承受病情或等待而不急躁
words.origin: 拉丁语 patiens（忍耐的、承受的），来自 pati
words.native_definition: a person receiving medical care, or someone able to wait calmly
words.core_concept: one who bears an affliction steadily without complaint – 愿意稳稳承受病痛或等待而不急躁
words.core_image: 病床上的人静静躺着，接受照护、不怨不躁
examples: The nurse checked on each patient.
Be patient with the slow process.
semantic_expansions: 病人：正在承受、接受治疗的人
有耐心的：能稳住等待不焦躁

words.root_logic: pati（承受）+ -ence → 稳稳承受等待与麻烦的能力
words.origin: 拉丁语 patientia（忍耐），来自 pati
words.native_definition: the capacity to accept delay or trouble without annoyance
words.core_concept: the steady bearing of waiting and hardship without snapping – 面对等待与麻烦仍稳稳不放、不崩裂
words.core_image: 一个人排队等了很久，仍平静如初不抱怨
examples: The task requires great patience.
She waited with patience for the news.
semantic_expansions: 耐心/忍耐：承受等待与麻烦而不急躁崩裂的能力

words.root_logic: im-（不）+ patient（忍耐）→ 不能安心等待、急不可耐
words.origin: 拉丁语 impatientia（不耐烦），来自 in＋pati
words.native_definition: unable to wait calmly, or eager to have something happen soon
words.core_concept: unwilling to bear delay, wanting it now – 不愿承受片刻等待、立时要到
words.core_image: 排队者来回数着步子，恨不能立刻轮到自己
examples: He grew impatient with the delays.
Children are impatient for the holiday.
semantic_expansions: 不耐烦的/急切的：不能安心等待、急于成事

words.root_logic: pass（承受）+ -ion → 强烈到使人几乎被卷挟过去的情感
words.origin: 拉丁语 passio（受苦、激烈情感），来自 pati
words.native_definition: a very strong feeling, especially love or enthusiasm
words.core_concept: an emotion so strong one feels swept or carried by it – 强烈到像被裹挟着走的情感
words.core_image: 一个人谈起所爱之事时，眼里近乎着了火
examples: She has a passion for music.
The argument was fought with passion.
semantic_expansions: 激情/热情：强烈到几乎把人卷走的情感
酷爱：对某事近乎难以自抑的热衷

words.root_logic: pass（承受）+ -ive → 处于承受、被作用一方的
words.origin: 拉丁语 passivus（被动的），来自 pati
words.native_definition: showing no active resistance; receiving action
words.core_concept: on the receiving end of action without doing – 处于被作用而自身不主动的一方
words.core_image: 一个人只是静静承受外力，不去推、不去挡
examples: He took a passive role in the debate.
The patient remained passive during treatment.
semantic_expansions: 被动的/消极的：处于被作用而不主动推动

words.root_logic: com-（共同）+ passion（承受）→ 与他人共同承受其苦
words.origin: 法语 compassion，来自拉丁语 com＋pati
words.native_definition: sympathetic concern for the suffering of others
words.core_concept: bearing another's pain alongside them as if shared – 与他人一同承受对方的苦楚
words.core_image: 老人跌倒时，旁人心里也像跟着疼了一下
examples: She showed great compassion for the refugees.
Compassion moved the doctor to volunteer.
semantic_expansions: 同情/怜悯：与他人的苦难一同承受而产生的关怀

words.root_logic: con-（完全）+ ced（让出）→ 完全让出、承认对方有理
words.origin: 拉丁语 concedere（让与），来自 con＋cedere
words.native_definition: to admit something is true, or give up a claim
words.core_concept: stepping fully aside to let the other side pass – 完全退让、把位置让给对方
words.core_image: 争执中一方慢慢退后，把原来的立场交出去
examples: She conceded that she was wrong.
The team conceded two goals.
semantic_expansions: 承认/让步：让出立场、承认对方有理
words.recall_hint: ced（让出）走到完全退让那一步，不再争持

words.root_logic: pre-（在前）+ ced（行走）→ 走在他人之前
words.origin: 拉丁语 praecedere（走在前面），来自 prae＋cedere
words.native_definition: to come before someone or something in time or order
words.core_concept: walking out ahead so others follow in sequence – 走在队伍最前面、他人随后
words.core_image: 开幕的号角声在前，正戏紧随其后上演
examples: A brief speech preceded the ceremony.
The storm was preceded by dark clouds.
semantic_expansions: 在…之前：时间或次序上先行一步

words.root_logic: re-（向后）+ ced（行走）→ 向后退去、退远
words.origin: 拉丁语 recedere（后退），来自 re＋cedere
words.native_definition: to move back or appear to move away
words.core_concept: walking backward, drawing away from the front – 朝后退行、远离当前
words.core_image: 退潮时水面一点点斜着往回缩
examples: The floods slowly receded.
The coastline receded into mist.
semantic_expansions: 退去/减退：向后退行、声势逐渐减弱

words.root_logic: pre-（在前）+ ced（行走）+ -ent → 走在前、可作先例再对照
words.origin: 拉丁语 praecedens（在先的），来自 praecedere
words.native_definition: an earlier event or ruling used as an example for later ones
words.core_concept: the earlier case that walks ahead and guides later ones – 走在前头、供后来者参照的先例
words.core_image: 先例书里那一册摆在前，后来的案子便照着走
examples: The ruling set a legal precedent.
There is no precedent for this decision.
semantic_expansions: 先例/判例：走在前、供后来者参照的既有之例

words.root_logic: con-（完全）+ stant（站立）→ 始终站定、不变化的
words.origin: 拉丁语 constans（不变的），来自 con＋stare
words.native_definition: not changing; happening all the time
words.core_concept: standing always in one fixed position unchanged – 一直站在原处、始终不变
words.core_image: 桌上的钟摆按同一节奏不停摆动，从不停歇
examples: The clock keeps a constant speed.
She lives under constant pressure.
semantic_expansions: 恒定的/持续的：一直站定不变、不间断

words.root_logic: in-（在上）+ stant（站立）→ 紧贴着眼前的当下、正立在当处
words.origin: 拉丁语 instans（正在进行的），来自 instare（立于其上）
words.native_definition: a very short moment of time; happening immediately
words.core_concept: the point that stands right up against the now – 紧贴在当下这一点上
words.core_image: 电光火石间那一瞬，几乎来不及眨眼
examples: He paused for an instant.
The message reached me in an instant.
semantic_expansions: 片刻/瞬间：紧贴现在的极短一瞬
立刻：就在当下发生

words.root_logic: instant（瞬间）+ -aneous → 发生在转眼之间、同时即至
words.origin: 英语 instantaneous，来自 instant
words.native_definition: happening immediately, without delay
words.core_concept: taking but the blink of an instant – 眨眼之间即发生、毫不拖延
words.core_image: 按下的按钮与亮起的光几乎同时完成
examples: The site gave instantaneous feedback.
Death was instantaneous.
semantic_expansions: 瞬间的/即时的：在眨眼之间即发生

words.root_logic: st（站立）+ -able → 能稳稳站住、不会倒下
words.origin: 拉丁语 stabilis（稳固的），来自 stare（站立）
words.native_definition: steady and not likely to change or collapse
words.core_concept: able to stand steadily without falling – 能安稳站立、不易倾倒
words.core_image: 一栋楼的地基打得深，风吹只晃不动
examples: The patient's condition is stable.
They built on stable ground.
semantic_expansions: 稳定的/牢固的：能稳立不倒、不易改变

words.root_logic: est-（站）+ -abl- + -ish → 使某物立起来并稳稳站住
words.origin: 拉丁语 stabilire（使稳固），来自 stare
words.native_definition: to set up something durable, or prove something as fact
words.core_concept: raising something onto solid footing where it stands firm – 把事物立起来使其稳固站定
words.core_image: 一块碑被深深埋住竖好，从此站在那里不再倒
examples: They established a new school.
The theory was established by evidence.
semantic_expansions: 建立/确立：把事物立稳、使其长久站定

words.root_logic: manu-（手）+ fact（做）+ -ure → 原指用手做出，后指量产制造
words.origin: 拉丁语 manufactura（手工制造），来自 manus＋facere
words.native_definition: to produce goods in large quantities
words.core_concept: making things by hand or machine at scale – 通过手或机器大批产出成品
words.core_image: 流水线上工位相接，一件件成品被造出来
examples: The plant manufactures car parts.
They manufacture goods for export.
semantic_expansions: 制造/生产：用手或机器成批做出物品

words.root_logic: bene-（好）+ fic（做出）+ -ial → 造出好处的、有利的
words.origin: 拉丁语 beneficialis（有益的），来自 beneficium（恩惠）
words.native_definition: producing good or helpful results
words.core_concept: making good come forth for someone – 为某人造出好处
words.core_image: 一场及时雨洒下，田地因此长势更好
examples: Regular exercise is beneficial to health.
The new law is beneficial to farmers.
semantic_expansions: 有益的/有利的：能为人带来好处与助益

words.root_logic: con-（共同）+ fin（界限）→ 把范围限制在共同划定的边界内
words.origin: 拉丁语 confinare（限定边界），来自 con＋finis
words.native_definition: to keep within set limits, or restrict a person
words.core_concept: holding something inside a fixed boundary line – 把事物限制在划定的界线之内
words.core_image: 乱跑的小动物被围栏圈回，出不了那道边
examples: The fire was confined to one room.
Please confine your remarks to the topic.
semantic_expansions: 限制/局限于：把范围关在既定边界之内

words.root_logic: de-（下、定）+ fin（界限）→ 为事物的边界下定义
words.origin: 拉丁语 definire（定界限），来自 de＋finire
words.native_definition: to state the exact meaning or limits of something
words.core_concept: setting down the boundary so a thing is clearly delimited – 划下界线把含义确定下来
words.core_image: 词典编者用一句话圈出那个词的确切边界
examples: Please define the key terms.
The rules define what is allowed.
semantic_expansions: 定义/界定：划定精确边界以确定含义

words.root_logic: re-（再次）+ fin（末端、纯净）→ 反复提纯、去除杂质
words.origin: 拉丁语 raffinare（提纯），来自 re＋fin
words.native_definition: to purify, or improve by removing unwanted parts
words.core_concept: re-passing something to its clean end state, stripping impurity – 反复过一遍把杂质滤净
words.core_image: 粗矿在炉中一再炼制，杂质一层层被剔除
examples: The company refines crude oil.
They refined the design over months.
semantic_expansions: 精炼/提纯：反复处理以滤除杂质
改进：去掉粗糙处使其更完善

words.root_logic: of-（ob- 迎面）+ fer（带来）→ 把东西带到面前供人取舍
words.origin: 拉丁语 offerre（呈上），来自 ob＋ferre
words.native_definition: to present something for acceptance or rejection, or a deal
words.core_concept: bringing a thing up to someone's face to take or refuse – 把物件呈到人前供其接或拒
words.core_image: 托盘被端到宾客面前，任他取用或推回
examples: She offered him a cup of tea.
He offered to help with the move.
semantic_expansions: 提供/提出：把事物呈到面前供人选择

words.root_logic: re-（回）+ fer（携带）→ 把目光或话题带回某处
words.origin: 拉丁语 referre（带回、提及），来自 re＋ferre
words.native_definition: to direct attention to, or mention as a source
words.core_concept: carrying attention back to a source or named thing – 把注意力带回所指之处
words.core_image: 读者顺着页码把问题带回那一段原文
examples: She referred to the report.
The doctor referred him to a specialist.
semantic_expansions: 提到/参考：把注意力引回某一来源或对象

words.root_logic: con-（共同）+ fer（携带）→ 共同带着意见来商谈，或把好处授予人
words.origin: 拉丁语 conferre（带到一起、授予）
words.native_definition: to award or grant, or to discuss with others
words.core_concept: bringing views together around a table, or bestowing worth on someone – 把众人意见带到一起商谈，或把一项荣誉带给人
words.core_image: 委员会围坐一处商议，最终把奖项授出
examples: The board conferred an honorary degree.
They conferred before deciding.
semantic_expansions: 授予/给予：把荣誉或权利交到人手上
商讨：把众人意见带到一处合计

words.root_logic: in-（入内）+ fer（携带）→ 从材料中把结论带出来
words.origin: 拉丁语 inferre（带入、推断），来自 in＋ferre
words.native_definition: to conclude by reasoning from evidence
words.core_concept: carrying a conclusion out from the given facts – 从已有材料中推出结论
words.core_image: 侦探从一串脚印里推出刚才发生的事
examples: We can infer the outcome from the data.
I inferred from his tone that he was angry.
semantic_expansions: 推断/推论：从已有事实中推出结论
